profiles.notes: Common qualification and English rules in the 2027 international guide.

requirements.label: GCE A-level · aggregate calculation
requirements.details: For a four-subject calculation use the strongest four A2 subjects. Score A*=6, A=5, B=4, C=3, D=2 and E=1. Exclude AS results and include at most one Applied A-level.

source.title: Sydney 2027 international guide, A-level aggregate, PDF p. 6

requirements.label: AP · standalone qualification and high-school GPA
requirements.details: International applicants can use three or four AP exam scores alongside secondary graduation and the applicable accredited US high school GPA on a 4.0 scale. Count scores of at least 3 and exclude the Calculus AB subgrade. Each course sets its applicable admission criteria.

source.title: Sydney recognised qualifications, United States AP route

requirements.label: AP · supporting an ACT or SAT score
requirements.details: The guide allows a lower SAT or ACT score when accompanied by AP results at grade 3 or above. The table does not publish course AP thresholds or adjustment amounts.

source.title: Sydney 2027 international guide, US test notes, PDF p. 8

requirements.label: English tests · result validity
requirements.details: English test results used for admission must be no more than two years old at the date the course starts.

source.title: Sydney 2027 international guide, English test scores, PDF p. 6
